svg.text: Know the facts · Protect · Stay healthy
Malaria is a life-threatening disease caused by Plasmodium
parasites and is transmitted to people through the bites of
infected female Anopheles mosquitoes. Fever, chills and
headache are common symptoms, but symptoms alone cannot
vector control, and other measures recommended
by local health authorities. Fever in an area
where malaria occurs should be assessed
promptly by a health professional and tested
Educational information · Not a diagnosis or replacement for professional care
